name: Laurus Labs Ltd.
institutional_thesis: Turnaround leader in CDMO & Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API). Operating leverage kicking in post-capex with strong recovery in commercial batches. US FDA clearance at Visakhapatnam formulations unit provides multi-year revenue visibility. High relative strength (+139% 1Y return) with sustained institutional accumulation.

name: Dixon Technologies Ltd.
institutional_thesis: Primary beneficiary of Government of India's Electronics PLI schemes. Mobile phone assembly contracts with global smartphone giants creating massive scale. Backward integration into display modules and precision components expanding margins.
catalysts: Operating leverage in high-volume smartphone segment

name: Trent Ltd. (Tata Group)
institutional_thesis: Zudio format represents the biggest retail success story in India with phenomenal unit economics. Westside maintaining industry-leading same-store sales growth. Zero long-term debt and continuous internal cash flow funding 200+ store additions annually.
catalysts: Star Bazaar grocery retail turning EBITDA positive
Rapid store addition pace accelerating market share

name: Suzlon Energy Ltd.
institutional_thesis: Complete balance sheet transformation from debt-heavy to net cash surplus. Order book at historical highs (>5.5 GW) with robust demand from C&I and PSU tenders. 3.x MW turbine technology commanding high pricing power and superior execution margins.
catalysts: Clean balance sheet driving institutional re-rating

name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd.
institutional_thesis: High-mix, high-value electronics manufacturing for defense, space, railways, and industrial IoT. Setting up an advanced OSAT semiconductor testing facility backed by Central/State subsidies. Revenue CAGR exceeding 40% with industry-leading EBITDA margins (>14%).
catalysts: Execution of massive Kavach railway safety system electronics

name: BSE Ltd.
institutional_thesis: Bankex and Sensex derivative contracts continuing to capture market share from NSE. StAR MF mutual fund platform processing over 45% of India's digital mutual fund transactions. High operating leverage ensures almost 80% of incremental revenue flows directly to operating profit.
catalysts: Sustained derivative volume market share gains (>22%)
Monetization of StAR MF platform transaction fees
New commodity and interest rate derivative product rollouts

name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd.
institutional_thesis: Monopoly aircraft & helicopter manufacturer for Indian Armed Forces. Order book visibility exceeding ₹1.2 lakh crore covering Tejas Mk1A, Prachand LCH, and ALH. High return on equity (>28%), zero debt, and robust dividend yield.
catalysts: Export agreements with friendly foreign nations (SE Asia / Africa)
Fifth-generation AMCA fighter jet development milestone

name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd.
institutional_thesis: Global leader in custom synthesis for top 10 pharmaceutical multinationals. Heavy investments into GLP-1 peptide intermediates creating huge multi-year revenue runway. Near-monopoly in contrast media APIs with fortress balance sheet.
catalysts: GLP-1 peptide commercial scale-up for global weight loss drugs
EBITDA margins reverting to historical 38-40% band
